parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by ensuring collation is propagated to foreign keys, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch modifies the type of foreign key columns, which could potentially break existing migrations or assumptions about column types in other parts of the application.
The code could be more readable with comments explaining why collation is being added to foreign key columns.
